summary: The CLI and console directly load plugin-react, but two project generators still emit version 4 after the workspace moves to version 5.

findings.title: Generated projects remain on plugin-react 4
findings.impact: The workspace upgrade exercises plugin-react 5 in the CLI and console, while both generators still write ^4.2.1. Newly generated applications and plugins will therefore remain on the previous major and will not validate the upgraded dependency path.
recommendedChecks: Generate one application and one plugin, install them from scratch, and decide explicitly whether their templates should move to plugin-react 5 with the workspace.

omittedConcerns: The Oxc and disableOxcRecommendation change is omitted because the supplied repository evidence does not show rolldown-vite, plugin-react-oxc, or that option.
